title: Seaside Escape Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the heart of Blue Mountain, this 4 bedroom ranch with private pool and beautiful landscaping offers a beachside oasis like no other.
description_expanded: Seaside Escape – Brand New to the rental market 2025 ranch style Home with Modern Luxury & Family Fun! HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - HUGE yard with ample parking; even for your boat! - Private Pool - 6 Seater Golf Cart (with signed liability waiver and $1000 refundable security deposit). - Yard games for the whole family - Gaming stations for the kids - 2 Beach cruiser bikes - Gas grill and pizza oven with outdoor TV and large seating area - Hibachi grill - Sandpiper welcome tote included for all rentals - Sandpiper Linen Participant. All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). - Use of the owner's golf cart with signed liability waiver and $1000 refundable security deposit Welcome to Seaside Escape, new to the rental market in Fall of 2025, a coastal retreat designed for unforgettable family vacations! This beautifully appointed home blends all the modern amenities you crave with the comforts of home you love. Spacious and Stylish! Every corner of this home is brand new; from sleek, modern finishes to cozy furnishings; creating a fresh and welcoming space for your entire group. Entertainment for All Ages! Kids (and kids at heart!) will love the retro video games, pool volleyball, and other fun surprises throughout the house. Adults can kick back and relax in stylish indoor and outdoor lounge areas. Hibachi Grill Experience! Gather around for a unique hibachi grilling experience; perfect for evening dinners or restaurant quality breakfasts! OR make your own pizzas and bake in the outdoor pizza oven! Rare 30A Feature! Room to Park a Boat or Trailer! The expansive lot includes a large wrap-around driveway with an extended section ideal for boat or trailer parking. A rare find in the 30A area! Easily access Blue Mountain Beach or explore Redfish Village, just moments away, using the included golf cart (additional refundable security deposit applies). Whether you want to have ice cream or enjoy a lunch or dinner out, be there in minutes! Whether you're planning a beach getaway, a family reunion, or a fun-filled retreat, Seaside Escape offers everything you need for a comfortable, convenient, and unforgettable stay on 30A. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Seaside Escape is a ranch, with all bedrooms located on the main level. - King Master with private en-suite bath (large soaking tub, separate shower), TV - King guest room with en-suite bath, Tub/shower combo, TV - Bunk room for the kids- sleeps 6 in twin beds (2 triple bunks), 2 TVs, games galore! En-suite bath, tub/shower combo - Double Queen bedroom, sleeps 4, TV - 1/2 bath in hall connecting to outdoor lounge space IMPORANT DETAILS - Please note the pool cannot be heated FREE WIFI
